what_happened: The ego was going straight on a wet freeway and closing fast on a slower white utility truck (actor 2) in its lane. At handoff (4.7 s) the gap was only 7.2 m with the ego at 7.9 m/s. The policy braked hard, down to 3.8 m/s, but its front still touched the truck at 5.7 s, and actor 41 behind then hit its rear. The ego stayed within about 0.4 m of where the human driver was, so this setup came from the replay before handoff, and the contact may be an artifact of how close the replayed truck was to the human's car.
